barriers.label: Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?
barriers.impact: The question "Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?" is not tied to its options, so a screen reader reads the options without it.

barriers.label: Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?
barriers.impact: All 2 options for "Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?" sound identical to a screen reader. The words "Yes" and "No" are never spoken.
barriers.fix: Remove the shared aria-label from each option so each is named by its own text ("Yes", "No"). Put the question in the group's <legend>.

pageBarriers.impact: The CV uploader can only be used by dragging a file onto it.
pageBarriers.fix: Keep the drop zone, and add a "Choose file" button that Tab reaches and that opens the file input.

pageBarriers.impact: A popup opened on this page but is not announced as a dialog.
pageBarriers.fix: Use a <dialog> opened with showModal(), or give the popup role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and a name from its heading.

pageBarriers.impact: Part of this page is a frame from 127.0.0.1:8765 that BRIDGE cannot reach. Any questions inside it are not listed.
